title: Software Updates in practice
intro: Updates close the door on attackers. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Planned update tonight

artifact.subject: Planned update tonight
body: After 19:00 today, work computers will update automatically.
Leave your computer on and just save your work. You do not need to download anything.

decisions.explain: No link, no file, nothing to download. It only informs you.

decisions.title: Message from Service

artifact.name: Service
body: Virus detected on your phone! Download the security update: fix-phone.example.info/app.apk

decisions.explain: Your phone does not send updates by SMS. This link installs a malicious app.

decisions.title: Video site asks for a player update
decisions.prompt: A video site says you must update your player. Real update or a trap?

artifact.title: Update your video player
body: This video needs the latest player.

decisions.explain: A site that says update your player to watch a video is a classic trap. Browsers play video on their own.

decisions.title: Your licence is expiring! Update required

artifact.subject: Your licence is expiring! Update required

decisions.explain: Updates do not arrive as email attachments. The archive may hide malware.

decisions.title: Message from Tech support (official)

artifact.name: Tech support (official)
body: To update your computer remotely, install this program and send me the code on your screen.

decisions.explain: A remote-control program gives the attacker full access to your computer. Call support yourself on a number you know.
